leadText:
Squirtle (Japanese: ゼニガメ Zenigame) is a character in Magical Pokémon Journey. He lives at and 's mansion and is apparently their butler. He can speak human language.

Squirtle has five sisters—two named Kameko and Kamemi, a named Kamena, and two younger Squirtle named Kameyo and Kamee.

==Personality and characteristics==
Since Almond was extremely nice to him at the first Christmas party, Squirtle greatly admires Almond and refers to him as his "big brother". Squirtle also seems to have a crush on Almond.
